interpretation_limits.scope: conditional comparison of NVML-reported participating-GPU board energy of the tested arms on this pair and host (pilot, 3 sessions); not global optima, not externally calibrated physical accuracy, no training or real-model claim
interpretation_limits.HD1: length dependence of J/op does not by itself identify a sensor-only mechanism: thermal and clock changes over the region can also change board energy
interpretation_limits.HD4: one selected C/A comparison (AllGather 2 MiB, 40 s, this pair); not evidence that global latency and energy optima differ
interpretation_limits.R1: offline R1 verifies the runner's recorded READY status only (no readiness-trace replay); R2 is recomputed from the recorded pre-region state with the frozen bands
interpretation_limits.adequacy: with the actual frozen calibration Q1 (primary not bounded) no aggregate scope can meet its statistical criteria and physical adequacy cannot be established; individual H-D1..H-D4 results can still be informative

provenance.checks: portable offline artifact checks (no NVML, no GPU, no live verify_freeze)
